equity.title: Equity
equity.simple: Equity means ownership. If you buy a company's stock, you own a small part of that company.
equity.example: Example: If you buy 1 share of Apple (AAPL), you own a tiny fraction of Apple.

volatility.title: Volatility
volatility.simple: Volatility means how much the price moves up and down over time. Higher volatility means bigger price swings.
volatility.example: Example: TSLA usually moves more per day than KO, so TSLA is more volatile.

moving average.title: Moving Average
moving average.simple: A moving average is the average price over a time window like 5 days or 20 days. It helps identify trends.
moving average.example: Example: SMA5 uses last 5 closing prices, SMA20 uses last 20 closing prices.
